Pupillary evaluation #22

  • Ana Banc, MD, PhD

Abnormal pupil #23

  • Color
  • White (leukocoria) - cataract, retinoblastoma
  • Yellow - endophthalmitis
  • Red - albinism (lack of melanin)
  • Shape
  • Oval, largest diameter vertically – glaucoma attack
  • “Keyhole shape” – iris coloboma
  • Irregular contour - posterior synechia

Abnormal pupil #30

  • Localization
  • Excentric – corectopia:
  • Congenital
  • Acquired: trauma, surgery, iris inflammation
  • Diameter
  • Miosis (< 2 mm):
  • iritis, keratitis
  • Midriasis (> 4 mm):
  • - Iris traumatic injury, optic nerve trauma, glaucoma attack (semimidriasis)
